notes: This contract directly maps the portable C++ Modify Lookahead TCK assertions to the pinned 2025 clause 8.20.4 requirements. For a requested decrease below actual lookahead, the case verifies that Query Lookahead continues to report the old actual value while the new request is pending, then verifies the request is retained and the actual lookahead proceeds by the logical-time amount advanced across successive grants until reaching the requested value. It also verifies that a standard HLAinteger64Interval/HLAfloat64Interval zero value is accepted and becomes active at its grant boundary. Negative interval construction is not represented by the official nonnegative standard interval types and is therefore not fabricated in this portable case.
